parlays.title: Bought points · 4 legs
parlays.about: Buys points on alternate spreads and totals (or takes the moneyline) to make each leg more likely, while the parlay still pays at least even money. Every rung is priced by the model's margin and total distribution; rungs the book prices more than 8% under fair value are skipped. At the main lines these 4 legs would pay +1456 with a 6% chance; with the bought points it pays +165 with a 45% chance.

legs.why: model 83% vs market 83%; 12 pts bought from -1.5 (+105, model 44%)
model 81% vs market 82%; 10 pts bought from -5.5 (+100, model 50%)
model 80% vs market 79%; 9 pts bought from -4.5 (-106, model 51%)

parlays.title: Model edge · 3 legs
parlays.about: The three main-line spreads or totals where the model disagrees most with the no-vig market. College basketball lines are sharp, so edges are small; this is the higher-variance pick.

legs.why: model 54% vs market 51%; book prices this rung 6% under fair

parlays.title: Moneyline favourites · 3 legs
parlays.about: Three teams the model is most confident will win outright, together paying at least even money.
